entry.title: Double feature - Basic Pitches + Et Voilà
entry.content:
Get ready for an unforgettable night of spontaneous storytelling and improvised music!

Basic Pitches, Zürich’s beloved musical improv troupe, is teaming up with the fantastic Et Voilà for a one-night-only experience where scenes, songs, and laughter unfold in real time!
